days.lo: I am learning to analyze and describe embedded (hidden) numbers (to 10) using 5-groups and number bonds.
sc: I can use objects to find two hidden numbers inside a given number.
I can use 5-groups to find two hidden numbers inside a given number.
I can use a number bond to represent two hidden numbers and a given number.

days.lo: I am learning to reason about embedded (hidden) numbers in varied configurations (different arrangements) using number bonds.
sc: I can count a set of pictures and circle the two parts I see.
I can make a number bond to match my circled pictures.
I can name the parts and whole of a number bond.

days.lo: I am learning to see and describe numbers of objects using 1 more within 5-group configurations (arrangements).
sc: I can use objects within a 5-group to find 1 more.
I can use the sentence frames:
“___is one more than___.” and  “One more than ___ is ___.” to explain my thinking.
I can represent my work in a number sentence.

days.lo: I am learning to represent put together math stories with number bonds and count on from one embedded number or part to totals of 6 and 7, and generate all expressions for each total.
sc: I can count on from one part (number) to find the total up to 6 and 7 using 5-group cards.
I can identify the two parts (numbers) that make 6 and 7.
I can represent the two parts and total in a number bond.
I can represent the two parts and total in a number sentence.

days.lo: I am learning to represent put together situations with number bonds and count on from one embedded number or part to totals of 8 and 9, and generate all expressions for each total.
sc: I can count on from one part (number) to find the total up to 8 and 9 using 5-group cards.
I can identify the two parts (numbers) that make 8 and 9.
I can represent the two parts and total in a number bond.
I can represent the two parts and total in a number sentence.

days.lo: I am learning to represent all the number pairs of 10 as number bonds from a given scenario, and generate all expressions equal to 10.
sc: I can use a Rekenrek bracelet to show partners of 10.
I can write an expression to match.
I can use the count on strategy to find the total.
I can represent the two parts and total in a number bond.

days.lo: I am learning to solve add to with result unknown and put together with result unknown math stories by drawing, writing equations, and making statements of the solution.
sc: I can draw a picture to solve a math story.
I can write a number sentence to solve a math story.
I can make a number bond to match a math story.

days.lo: I am learning to solve put together with result unknown math stories by drawing and using 5-group cards.
sc: I can hear a math story and draw a picture to match it.
I can write a number sentence to match my picture.
I can use 5-group cards to match a problem story.
I can count on to solve my word problem.
I can use my pictures to write a number bond.

days.lo: I am learning to solve add to with change unknown math stories as a context for counting on by drawing, writing equations, and making statements of the solution.
sc: I can count on and draw pictures to solve a math story.
I can state how many more pictures I had to draw.
I can write a number sentence to match a math story.
I can write a number bond to match a math story.

days.lo: I am learning to solve add to with change unknown math stories using 5-group cards.
sc: I can use 5-group cards to solve a math story.
I can create a mystery change story to go with a number sentence.
I can use 5-group cards to find missing numbers in a number sentence.
I can draw a picture and count on to solve a math story.

days.lo: I am learning to tell put together with result unknown, add to with result unknown, and add to with change unknown stories from equations.
sc: I can make up a math story to match a number sentence.
I can complete the number sentence.
I can draw a picture to show what is happening in the math story.
I can write a number bond to match the math story.

days.lo: I am learning to count on up to 3 more using numeral and 5-group cards and fingers to track the change.
sc: I can count on using my fingers to solve addition problems.
I can count on using 5-group cards to solve addition problems.
I can count on to solve number sentences.

days.lo: I am learning to count on to find the unknown part in missing addend equations such as 6 + __ = 9 and answer “How many more to make…” questions.
sc: I can count on using my fingers to solve for the missing addend in an equation.
I can count on using 5-group cards to solve for  the missing addend in an equation.
I can draw more pictures needed to solve for the missing addend in an equation.

days.lo: I am learning to understand the meaning of the equal sign by pairing equivalent expressions and constructing true number sentences.
sc: I can use linking cubes to create a true number sentence.
I can write an expression that will complete a true number sentence.
I can find two expressions that are equal.
I can explain what the equal sign tells us.

days.lo: I am learning to represent the same story scenario with addends repositioned (the commutative property).
sc: I can write two number sentences that match my double-sided counters.
I can look at a picture and write a number bond to match it.
I can write two number sentences to match the number bond.
I can rewrite a number sentence by switching the two addends around.

days.lo: I am learning to apply the commutative property to count on from a larger addend.
sc: I can write a number sentence starting with the larger addend.
I can count on from the larger addend to determine the solution.
I can complete a number bond and write a number sentence to match.

days.lo: I am learning to visualize and solve doubles and doubles plus 1 with 5-group cards.
sc: I can write a doubles number sentence.
I can solve a doubles problem.
I can write a doubles plus 1 number sentence.
I can solve a doubles plus 1 problem.
I can use doubles to solve a doubles plus 1 problem.

days.lo: I am learning to look for and make use of repeated reasoning on the addition chart by solving and analyzing problems with common addends.
sc: I can use the addition chart to help me analyze and reason about problems that have a common addend.
I can solve problems with the same common addend.
I can complete an addition chart by filling in the missing numbers.

days.lo: I am learning to look for and make use of structure on the addition chart by looking for and coloring problems with the same total.
sc: I can use the addition chart to find expressions that have the same total and color their boxes in.
I can use the addition chart to write number sentences that have the same total.

days.lo: I am learning to build fluency with facts to 10.
sc: I can write an expression on a related fact ladder and explain how that expression is related to the one before it.
I can solve number sentences and color code it based on the type of number sentence it is.

days.lo: I am learning to solve add to with change unknown math stories.
sc: I can break up the total in a math story that uses objects or pictures.
I can write a number bond to match the math story.
I can write an addition number sentence to match the math story.
I can write a subtraction number sentence to match the math story

days.lo: I am learning to count on using the number path to find an unknown part.
sc: I can use a number path to count on when solving an addition problem.
I can write the addition number sentence to match.
I can use a number path to count back when solving a subtraction problem.
I can write the subtraction number sentence to match.

days.lo: I am learning to count on using the number path to find an unknown part.
sc: I can use a number path and decide to count on or count back to find an unknown part.
I can write a number sentence to match.
I can use the number path to help me write a number bond.

days.lo: I am learning to solve take from with result unknown math stories.
sc: I can solve a take from problem by drawing a picture and crossing off what is taken away.
I can draw a number bond to match.
I can write a number sentence to match.
I can write a statement with the solution.

days.lo: I am learning to solve take apart with addend unknown math stories.
sc: I can solve a take apart addend unknown math story by drawing a picture and circling the known part to find the unknown.
I can solve an addend unknown math story by writing a subtraction number sentence.
I can use a number bond to help me solve a math story.

days.lo: I am learning to solve add to with change unknown math stories.
sc: I can solve a math story using a number bond.
I can solve a math story by drawing a picture.
I can write an addition number sentence to match the math story.
I can write a subtraction number sentence to match the math story.

days.lo: I am learning to solve take from with change unknown math stories.
sc: I can solve a take from with change unknown math story by drawing a picture, circling the known part, and crossing out the unknown.
I can use a number bond to help me solve a math story.
I can write a number sentence to help me solve a math story.

days.lo: I am learning to solve put together/ take apart with addend unknown math stories.
sc: I can use a simple math drawing to solve a problem.
I can use the math drawing to make a number bond.
I can write an addition and subtraction number sentence to solve a problem
I can explain my work and thinking.

days.lo: I am learning to model 0 less and 1 less.
sc: I can model 0 less and 1 less using a bead (number) bracelet.
I can model 0 less and 1 less using a 5-group drawing.
I can model 0 less and 1 less using a subtraction number sentence.

days.lo: I am learning to model n - n (subtract all) and n - (n - 1)  (subtract all but 1).
sc: I can use a bead bracelet to model subtract all and subtract all but one.
I can model subtract all and subtract all but 1 using a 5-group drawing.
I can use subtraction number sentences to model subtract all and subtract all but one.

days.lo: I am learning to relate subtraction facts involving fives and doubles to corresponding decompositions.
sc: I can relate and solve subtraction facts using the math way.
I can relate and solve subtraction facts using a math bracelet (beads).
I can relate and solve subtraction facts using a 5-group drawing.
I can draw a number bond to match.
I can explain the strategy used.

days.lo: I am learning to relate subtraction from 10 to corresponding decompositions.
sc: I can solve subtraction problems from 10 using a bead (number) bracelet.
I can complete a number bond.
I can write two related subtraction sentences that match the number bond.
I can solve subtraction problems from 10 using 5-group drawings.

days.lo: I am learning to relate subtraction from 9 to corresponding decompositions.
sc: I can solve subtraction problems from 9 using a bead (number) bracelet.
I can complete a number bond.
I can write two related subtraction sentences that match the number bond.
I can solve subtraction problems from 9 using 5-group drawings.

days.lo: I am learning to look and make use of repeated reasoning and structure using the addition chart to solve subtraction problems.
sc: I can look for and make use of repeated reasoning and structure using the addition chart to solve subtraction problems.
I can analyze the addition chart to create sets of related addition and subtraction facts.
I can create my own set of addition flashcards.

days.lo: I am learning to analyze the addition chart to create sets of related addition andsubtraction facts.
sc: I can use the addition chart to write sets of related addition and subtraction facts.
